sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a deep pit inside the makers' clockwork house, pale stone banded in brass, cogs turning in the dark below. Over the pit a great pale stone disc hangs from an arm and swings across like a clock's escapement. Over the far door a dial with one brass hand and three carved stone eyes round it; the eye the hand points at glows, and the next one round the way a clock goes is lighting. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack stands on the near ledge firing a splash of glowing fluid at the third eye, dwarfed by the pit; on the far landing a stone ball waits at the head of a groove. Warm light from high round windows. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, pale stone, brass, teal accents, warm window light, deep umber shadows in the pit, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, numbers.
